body.name: \(\mathcal E_4(T_0)\)
body.construction: In the specialization \(N=3,r=s=1\), index the maximal-margin loading lines by \(\mathcal H_4\), set \(u_h=h/\sqrt3\), and form the four composite Gaussian hypotheses \(\mathbb P_{h,d,f,\sigma}:\operatorname{vec}(Y_0)\sim\mathcal N(\operatorname{vec}(u_hdf),\sigma^2I_{3T_0})\). Profile each hypothesis over \(d\in[d_{\mathrm{lo}},d_{\mathrm{hi}}]\), \(f\mathbf1_{T_0}=0\), \(\lVert f\rVert_2^2=T_0\), \(\lVert f\rVert_\infty\le K\), and \(\sigma\in[\sigma_{\mathrm{lo}},\sigma_{\mathrm{hi}}]\). The decision rule is \(\widehat h=\arg\min_{h\in\mathcal H_4}\lVert\widehat P-P_h\rVert_{\mathrm{op}}\) under the fixed tie rule, and its profiled risk is \(\max_{h\in\mathcal H_4}\sup_{d,f,\sigma}\mathbb P_{h,d,f,\sigma}(\widehat h\ne h)\).
